A.title: The Long Stacks
A.text: Rows of shelves run further than the lamplight. Each book has an ice skin you can crack with a thumbnail. Read slowly. The cold gets into your hands before the words get into your head.

Y.title: The Founding Charter
Y.text: The charter is frozen in a block by the door. It says the archive keeps everything and gives nothing back to the ones who forget. The seal belongs to the first Warden.

R.title: Marginal Note, Frozen
R.text: Still your breath and your hands. The cold only bites a body that keeps moving. Calm is a weapon here.

G.title: A Scholar's Argument
G.text: Two scholars debated here until the fire went out. The ice kept their argument. One of them is wrong in a very detailed way, over four hundred pages.

M.title: The Warden's Rule
M.text: Do not read aloud in the stacks. Return what you open. The first Warden wrote these rules, and the archive still counts who broke them.

O.title: Missing Volumes
O.text: A shelf of gaps where books should be. The labels remain: the Accord, the Forgetting, the Cycle. Someone took them, or the cold did.

U.title: Frost on the Glass
U.text: Breathing on the case clears a patch for a moment. Under it, the record of a war between two ages that ended in peace. The peace is written smaller than the war.

X.title: The Last Tome
X.text: The final book on the last shelf is blank. A note tucked in it says: what you do not write down, you will not keep. Write something.
